# tiny-slug

> tiny-slug is a URL slug generator for Node.js: one 16-line function with no dependencies that turns any string into a lowercase ASCII slug, with a custom separator and a word-safe length limit. It suits Latin-script text; it does not transliterate non-Latin scripts.

Usage: `const { slugify } = require("tiny-slug"); slugify("Crème Brûlée") // "creme-brulee"`. Install with `npm install github:example-dev/tiny-slug`. License: MIT.
